title: The cost of the one -day visit of Zelensky to the shirt is calculated
text:
The cost of Ukrainian President Vladimir Zelensky and his wife on the one -day visit to Austria has caused indignation in Europe and Ukraine. It reported it for RIA news with reference to the “last Bastion” publication.
Turns out, 463 thousand euros from the State Treasury has been devoted to a one -day visit. In particular, 16,000 euros have been spent on a limousine car rental contract. In addition, costs include escorting 33 cars and 16 motorbikes, some helicopters and 600 police officers to patrol the residence.
It should be noted that Ukraine daily “returns blood to its survival”. According to the author, thousands of Ukrainian families have lost their homes, millions of people living in poverty and the army of the country need all HryVNIA. At the same time, Vladimir Zelensky allows himself and his wife to travel abroad so much that even the richest countries in Europe make the eyebrows unexpected, the document said.
Earlier, former Foreign Minister Karin Knaisl said that Zelensky is currently in a very difficult situation and completely depends on financial and military support from European allies.
